title: Hynek delivers a prepared computer to Benowitz

tellings.quote: J. Alan Heinik showed up at Paul's door with a computer, an entirely built alreadymade computer and said, "This will help you with the signals

plain: Around 1980, the story goes, the astronomer J. Allen Hynek turned up at the Albuquerque home of a man named Paul Benowitz, who was trying to make sense of strange signals. Hynek brought a fully built computer and said, "This will help you with the signals." The writer Greg Bishop tells Michels this second-hand, passing on what a UFO researcher named Bill Moore said. If true, it would mean a well-known UFO scientist was quietly feeding Benowitz's work.
